name: Seigi no Henshin Heroine o Sasaeru Ore to Aku no Onna Kanbu
original_name: 正義の変身ヒロインを支える俺と悪の女幹部
source:
In this "DEFEAT-ENDING" ADV game, the protagonist is honeyd*cked by an executive villainess!
The protagonist supports his childhood friend who is a justice transforming heroine, but a number of the executive villainess' seductions draw near to him. Besides, a Japanese teacher who earns popularity among students, Megumi-sensei, comes to make eyes at him!?
How will you deal with many sexual temptations which will successively happen to you along the story!?
Which "DEFEAT ENDING" will you choose!?
